highest_stakes_industry: hr-recruitment when automation can reject access to livelihood
human_in_loop_decisions: A human with evidence, time and override authority must review any action affecting grade, discipline, education access or employment access.
strongest_guardrails: Ban sole-source adverse decisions;require traceable evidence and reason code;provide appeal;pause on threshold breach.
cross_industry_pattern: Provisional individual synthesis pending real group discussion: across the documented education detector and hiring settlement, risk becomes unacceptable when an uncertain AI signal is converted into an adverse decision without meaningful review and appeal; this pattern keeps grading and misconduct decisions outside the UniTutor release roadmap.
